set.body:
Make scientific capabilities independently optional and demonstrate interoperable table semantics using ordinary files.

Acceptance criteria

1. An assessment-only profile registers without an editor or view compiler. The API and console report available operations consistently.
2. Historical and archival identity tests isolate unrelated processor changes. An archive curated into BIDS has a reviewed, finite path with permitted provenance.
3. Two studies with a column named score and participant sub-01 can be exported and queried with their own variable definitions and participant scopes.

Verification

Compatibility corpus, registry fixtures, linked curation rehearsal and the two-study table oracle.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: EP13: Extend scientific profiles without coupling archival storage to new methods
